utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive get a date yet, or are we still figuring that out?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard a date yet, but I’ll ask around when I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — let me know if you hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can bring over some tools for the repair drive. Let me know what you’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, uh, thanks Gus — I think we’re good on tools for now, but I may have missed what’s still needed. If you’ve got a wrench or a screwdriver, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got both — I’ll swing by with a wrench and a screwdriver. If you find anything else you’re missing, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout this time—folks are really showing up. I’ll pass along any updates if I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s good to hear—I'm just hoping the drop-off and pickup times are clear, because I don’t want anyone waiting around with boxes in the way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, that’s the last thing we need—I'll ask around and see if anyone’s posted the times clearly. If I hear something solid, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you check the donation bin by the community center and let me know if it needs to be moved?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’ll check the donation bin by the community center and let you know if it needs moving.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Uli, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive—come by if you can, it’d be great to see you there!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll try to stop by if I’m able.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Uli — no pressure at all, just swing by if you can. I’ll keep you posted on the details!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted. Leo, what do you want me to prioritize first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Start with the most urgent repairs first, then send me the list and timeline.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Got it — I’ll start with the most urgent repairs and send you the list plus timeline as soon as I’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what the repair drive needs and when it’s happening?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m sorry, I don’t have the details yet—could you send me the list and time again?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — I’ll send the repair list and the time again so we’re both set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate that around the school run—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s kind of you, Faye—thank you. I’m still waiting on the final time, but I’ll let you know as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mara — just send it over when you have it and I’ll work around the school run.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a good turnout. If there’s anything I can help with, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s so kind, Nell — I might take you up on that. We’re still sorting a few odds and ends, so I’ll let you know where you’d be most helpful.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Of course — just send me a quick update when you know. I’m happy to pitch in wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in for the repair drive — just send me the time and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — can you confirm you’re good for Saturday morning, and do you have a truck or any tools to bring?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday morning works for me. I’ve got a small set of tools, but no truck.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still figuring out the repair drive—what part do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I keep mixing up the details, sorry—could you help me sort out what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — let’s go through it together and make a quick list of what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll pass the repair drive plan along to everyone nearby.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll make sure the supply list is ready if anyone needs it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll let folks know about the plan and point them to your supply list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I’ve been meaning to ask—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s going steadily—people have been dropping off a few things. I’m still gathering what we need, though.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s good to hear. If you’re still short on anything, I can keep an eye out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to bring the tools by, but I’m a bit all over the place today. What do you need me to help with?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’ll just go over the list again and we can split it up. If you can bring the tools, that’ll cover a big part of it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll grab the tools and swing by soon. Just give me a reminder if I start wandering off again.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Still gathering a few parts and tools. I’ll swing by once I’ve got them sorted.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, thanks — just let me know when you’re ready to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll make a quick list and let you know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — take your time and I’ll set them aside once you send it over.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do first?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mara! Could you spread the word to a few neighbors and let them know we’re looking for volunteers and tool donations?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word to a few neighbors and mention we’re looking for volunteers and tool donations.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need me to spread the word about?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — please spread the word that we’re meeting at the community center parking lot for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word that the repair drive meets at the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can help organize the repair drive and keep things moving. Let’s make a simple list of what’s needed and who can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — I’ll check our supplies and write down what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll draft the checklist and we can compare notes once you’ve finished. Then we’ll split the tasks and get everything lined up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s getting organized, but I’m still piecing it together from the word around the block. If you’ve got the details, I’d really appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ve only heard it’s being put together right now. Do you want me to ask around for the date and what they need?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks. If you hear anything about the date or what they need, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in—just point me to the repair drive details and I’ll keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send the repair drive details and keep it simple for you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—send it over, and I’ll take care of the basics.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what kind of help you mean for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I mean I can pitch in with hands-on repairs, organizing supplies, or helping coordinate volunteers—whatever’s most useful.
